dct_creator_sm: Terry, Jacob (University of Waterloo). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6314-1412
dct_description_sm: This survey was administered online from 2021-04-30 to 2021-07-31

The objective of this research study was to assess which factors influence people in northwest Waterloo to choose different modes of travel when making trips in the Region of Waterloo.

The dataset contains the processed data from the survey, which has been anonymized following the associated research ethics protocol.
dct_title_s: Determining Preference for Transit-Integrated Ridesourcing Models in Northwest Waterloo, Ontario, 2022 [Waterloo, Ontario, Canada]
